# Controlled SMB fixture

This container is an isolated, read-only Samba origin for the explicit
`rcloneintegration` tests. It is not shipped, not a relay, and not a replacement
for rclone. Samba is GPLv3-or-later; the official Debian base is pinned by its
published image index digest. The fixture build prints the installed Samba
version. Package resolution belongs to the disposable runner job, not the host.

From the server module, `bash internal/rcloneprogram/testdata/run-native-fixtures.sh`
installs the locked rclone test executable in owned scratch, builds this exact
job-labelled fixture, runs the three native mixed workloads and cleans up on
success or failure. Use the admitted remote runner and a canonical private
`TMPDIR`; `-race` may be passed for a focused race round. No host install is made.

Build with `docker build --network=host --label portico=remote-sources-r40 --label "portico.job=$PORTICO_SAMBA_TEST_JOB" --iidfile "$TMPDIR/samba-image" internal/rcloneprogram/testdata/smb`.
Set `PORTICO_SAMBA_TEST_IMAGE` to that exact image ID and
`PORTICO_SAMBA_TEST_JOB` to a unique safe job label before running
`TestLockedSMBMixedOperationBudget`. The test uses the runner network namespace
but binds only loopback, mounts only
its throwaway media directory read-only, and retires its own labelled container.
The job must also remove containers matching its exact job label and its exact
image in a shell exit trap, including on test timeout. Do not prune Docker.

The guest share contains generated bytes only. No owner's SMB account, native
authentication, real media or database enters the container. Measured socket
count is a fact; SMB may retain idle pooled sockets beyond active admitted
operations. The same-file workload does not itself prove read coalescing.
